title: BETTE bathtubs, shower trays & washbasins | High-quality bathroom solutions at SHK Badshop
content: ## **For your best bathroom**. **Discover high-quality bathroom elements in glazed titanium steel – impressive in design and precision-crafted.**. Since 1952, Bette has been committed to the natural materials glass and steel, which are combined to form durable steel enamel. The products made of enamelled titanium steel last longer than other materials and are the best choice for the bathroom. The next generation and your children will thank you. No matter whether your bathroom is large or small - Bette offers a variety of bathtub models in different versions to perfectly fit your bathroom concept. Whether you prefer a built-in or a freestanding bathtub, a corner or a rounded bathtub - Bette has the perfect solution for you. Bette shower trays are not only functional elements, but also unique design objects, adding a touch of luxury to your daily life. **The perfect washbasin for every bathroom**. From classic built-in washbasins and space-saving wall-mounted washbasins to elegant undermount and stylish countertop washbasins, Bette offers a wide range of designs.
